artifacts.published_wire: JSON result: conversation_id/status/response:string; duration_seconds/num_turns:number; usage:object. Conditional fields: error:string, structured_output/json_schema:object. Stream selectors: .event=init|step_update|result; corresponding payload keys match. Identity locations: init-event .conversation_id, .step_update.conversation_id, .result.conversation_id. Step fields include step_index,state,step_type,text_delta,duration_seconds,usage,tool_name,tool_info,subagent_info. Published states include ACTIVE/DONE; step categories include user_input/agent_response/tool/checkpoint. tool_info carries name,parameters,output and optional error:{type,message}. Usage keys: input_tokens,output_tokens,thinking_tokens,cache_read_tokens,total_tokens. Step usage covers that step; stream-input result usage, duration and num_turns accumulate within the process session; response covers its current turn. .init.model appears when overridden; this does not establish a resolved backend model/provider. [Headless field tables and examples](https://www.antigravity.google/docs/cli/headless/).

artifacts.release_specific_corrections: The pinned changelog records stream output in 1.1.8 and stream input in 1.1.15. In 1.1.20, benign tool errors/permission denials ceased making the overall run fail. In 1.1.27, JSON gained denied_actions and print shutdown was fixed to preserve trailing history. Thus success alone does not establish that requested tools ran. The exact denied_actions item schema remains unresolved. The same release permits a one-prompt model switch followed by restoration, so session configuration alone cannot establish every producing model. [Pinned release evidence, lines 9–20, 108, 165, 308–312](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/blob/1ae9cb7b51667192c051b73a91099c71e816ca5f/CHANGELOG.md).
artifacts.identity_and_resume: Published controls: --conversation ID selects a prior conversation; --continue/-c selects the latest. [CLI reference](https://www.antigravity.google/docs/cli/reference/). For stream input, send {"event":"user","message":{"content":"synthetic prompt"}}; content also accepts text blocks. One init precedes per-turn results; closing stdin finishes the active turn and exits. [Headless protocol](https://www.antigravity.google/docs/cli/headless/). The separate TUI status-line schema exposes conversation_id, its session_id alias, optional transcript_path, and model.id/display_name. Its example uses ~/.gemini/antigravity/brain/ID/.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl and version 1.0.13, whereas the report claims antigravity-cli. This does not settle the installed headless root. That schema lists no provider field. [Status-line schema](https://www.antigravity.google/docs/cli/statusline/). Actual-model/provider selectors in headless results or transcript rows remain unresolved.
